findings.F1_missing_constraint: Under P3 the W commitment is re-randomised per proof (zk.rs:2436-2468, pcs::commit_zk_owned); verify_layer_zk_v3 absorbs whatever root the proof carries (zk.rs:3505-3515); the header model= string (zk.rs:228-290, absorbed at zk.rs:3504) binds the DECLARATION only. Two distinct hidden weight tensors verify under one declared model, statement and input. Recorded as a MISSING CONSTRAINT, not as P3 identity enforcement.
findings.F2_no_stable_identity_in_proof: Two proofs of the SAME approved weights carry different W roots; a copied root is rejected only because the root is in the transcript (binding, not identity).
findings.F3_p1_boundary: ApprovedP1Layer (model_identity.rs) pins the REGISTERED public W root/rows/log_cols (:241-250), every StatementV3 field (:219-234), LayerParams (:235-240), mode (:215-218), canonical NTT, fixed domain; refuses P3 (:265-275). The registered root is computed by the caller from approved public weights before any proof exists.
findings.F4_calibration_exponents: V3Exps reach the statement only via the four signed shifts; a rescaled export (7 exponents moved, shifts and table member fixed) gives a byte-identical statement and byte-identical proof at one seed. The proof relation is exponent-free; the manifest must pin exponents and the verifier must decode with the manifest's. Both the ordinary verifier and the P1 boundary accept the rescaled calibration today.
findings.F5_layer_position: The layer index l is absorbed (layer.rs:1396) but nothing binds WHICH hidden tensors sit at position l: identity must be one approved commitment per layer.
findings.F6_request_replay: The verifier receives no request identity; one P3 proof verifies for any number of requests under the same domain. Caller obligation (nonce / I-O commitments in the domain or statement), unchanged by the proposed construction.
findings.F7_randomness_reuse: The randomness stream is witness-independent: same seed + different weights -> identical mask_root. Undetectable by a single-proof verifier; prover-side obligation.

proposal.recommended_first_implementation: (b) budgeted stable hiding commitment per layer, opened directly by the FFN proof: q_pad = k*Q pad symbols per row, k precommitted mask-row sets (3*nb_d*nb_f + 1 rows each), a public slot index i < k in the header, write-ahead slot counter, refusal at budget; verifier compares proof.w_com to the manifest's C*_l exactly as ApprovedP1Layer compares roots; ZkOpts (q_pad) and W inverse rate come from the manifest, not ZkOpts::standard.
proposal.hiding_argument: DERIVED from pcs.rs encode_row_zk: rows encode f + Z_n*g on the coset; any |J| <= q_pad opened positions are uniform (Vandermonde surjectivity of the pad); group/prox vectors and W block terminals need one unused uniform mask row per slot. Bounded-reuse simulator stated, NOT written or checked here (FA2/FA3 item H1).
proposal.soundness_dependence: row degree < n + q_pad -> RS distance 1 - (n+q_pad)/nn: 0.746 (k=1), 0.688 (k=16), 0.5 (k=64) at inverse rate 4; hold distance at k=64 with W inverse rate 8. Numeric bound is FA5's; none inherited.
proposal.alternative_a: fresh per-proof C_i + registered C* + masked equality sumcheck (private_seam.rs shape generalised to 3*d*f): needs the SAME budgeted C*, keeps the per-proof W commit (largest P3 phase), adds ~26 MB per layer proof and a 2^28-point sumcheck; kept as the ROTATION primitive (C*_old -> C*_new without approver recomputation).
proposal.approval_source: signed manifest (digest D_M = blake3 of canonical bytes) loaded by the verifier from its own configuration; per layer: StatementV3 fields, V3Exps (9), LayerParams, C*_l, ZkOpts, W inv_rate, budget k, mask layout version; export sidecar sha256 and per-tensor digests; header model=hex(D_M)|layer=l|slot=i under a NEW profile tag. Approver recomputes C*_l from the evaluated tensors and the owner's registration randomness. A model-name string or a root copied from a proof cannot satisfy it.
proposal.scorpius_citation: ePrint 2024/1164 NOT opened this session; cited only as recorded by U_PERF3_ROUTE_B_WEIGHT_PRIVACY.md section 3.1 and ZK60_RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md (section 4.7 rules out repeated Eval for its ZK goal). Construction (b) invokes Eval k times on one commitment and therefore does NOT rest on that theorem; it rests on the explicit bounded-reuse argument that must be proven separately.
proposal.handoff: H1 FA2/FA3/FA5 simulator + rate bound; H2 Codex new stable-commitment module; H3-H4 Codex zk.rs prover/verifier paths under a new profile (frozen fixtures byte-identical); H5 Codex ApprovedP3Layer + manifest in model_identity.rs; H6 Claude CL1 chunked commit at budgeted width, planner q_pad<=n limit, stored-codeword (174-380 GiB for 32 layers) vs re-derive decision; H7 pass-level identity and request binding; H8 rotation via (a).
